title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 10721 E Jefferson Ave in Detroit, Michigan, as the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on June 21, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 10721 E Jefferson Ave in Detroit, Michigan, as the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building."

summary.headline: A Detroit, Michigan post office building is officially renamed the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 10721 E Jefferson Ave in Detroit, Michigan, a new official name. The building will be called the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the name change took effect at that time.
